item.title: Notes on Gamma
item.description:
📝 "The nonlinearity of a CRT is very nearly the inverse of the lightness sensitivity of human vision. The nonlinearity causes a CRT’s response to be roughly perceptually uniform. Far from being a defect, this feature is highly desirable.

item.title: CRISPR Fungus: Protein-Packed, Sustainable, and Tastes Like Meat
item.description:
📝 Knowledge Center Biotech Updates November 26, 2025 Issue CRISPR Fungus: Protein-Packed, Sustainable, and Tastes Like Meat CRISPR Fungus: Protein-Packed, Sustainable, and Tastes Like Meat November 26, 2025 Researchers used CRISPR to enhance a naturally meat-like fungus. Photo Source: Xiao Liu Researchers have successfully used CRISPR gene editing technology to create a fungi strain that is highly efficient, more nutritious, and significantly more sustainable than its natural counterpart. For more details, read this article or download the open-access paper.
🔗 Read more: https://www.isaaa.org/kc/cropbiotechupdate/article/default.asp?ID=21607
